note: Realistic filled-in states in the kinesiology-assessment scoring engine's shape. Graded on the Functional Movement Screen (FMS): seven patterns each 0-3 (bilateral patterns take the lower of left/right; pain during movement scores 0), summed 0-21, categorised >=18 Excellent, 14-17 Good, 10-13 Fair, <10 Poor, with an injury risk band (>=15 low-risk else at-risk). `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.additionalFlags via flagsHint "detectAdditionalFlags" with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectAdditionalFlags(state); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.
